description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): atelier-fj1t's change (4402d727), which makes land refuse a done claim made on the base outside review. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 68, atelier-uw4x): land counts only commits an approval's pin contains, so a close after approval that merge accepts is refused by land. The reviewer of atelier-t2vb, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
